resources.string: To cover the screen while you use other apps, Privacy Screen needs the \"Display over other apps\" permission.
A darker screen stays readable when you look straight at it but washes out quickly for people looking from the side.
A fine pattern, similar to the slats in a privacy screen protector, that breaks up the image at an angle and at a distance.
Black out everything except a band of the screen. Drag the handle on the right edge to move the band.

• Lower your phone's brightness: the filter works best on a dim screen.
• Turn on dark mode in the apps you use.
• Use the reading spotlight in crowded places.

Note: an app can't change how the display's pixels emit light, so no software filter can fully hide the screen from side angles the way a hardware privacy protector can. For the strongest protection, combine this app with a privacy screen protector.
Drag to move the reading band
